events.verdict: Thompson (CLE) briefly grasps the jersey of Carter Jr. (CHI) as he runs up to set the ball screen but does not affect his freedom of movement.
Nance Jr. (CLE) makes contact with Carter Jr.'s (CHI) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Holiday (CHI) has his left arm around the back and opposite side of Hood (CLE) but the move is tactile in nature as he quickly slides the arm off when Hood begins to move away.
Thompson (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact on LaVine's (CHI) shot.
Sexton (CLE) makes marginal contact with the arms of LaVine (CHI) after his gather on the driving shot attempt.
Nance Jr. (CLE) makes marginal contact with his forearm to the side of Carter Jr. (CHI) but he does not extend his arm to dislodge Carter Jr. from his legally obtained position.
Carter Jr. (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Hood's (CLE) dunk.
Thompson (CLE) and Carter Jr. (CHI) are in the path of each other when they engage and disengage on the screen.
Parker (CHI) is in the path of Smith (CLE) when he firms up in a legal picking position.
Thompson (CLE) makes high-five contact with LaVine's (CHI) hand after he has released the ball.
Carter Jr. (CHI) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Arcidiacono (CHI) engages with Nance Jr. (CLE) on the pick as he has an arm around the opposite side hip but the contact is tactile in nature as he immediately slides the arm off.
Nance Jr. (CLE) is in the path of the Arcidiacono (CHI) when he sets a wide screen but does not make lower leg to leg contact.
Nance Jr. (CLE) uses a swim move to engage with Arcidiacono (CHI) on the rebound and briefly clamps his arm but does not affect his ability to get the rebound.
Thompson (CLE) is in a legal guarding position when he picks up the errant pass from LaVine (CHI) to Carter Jr. (CHI).
Arcidiacono (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Sexton's (CLE) shot.
Parker (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Sexton (CLE) and cleanly blocks the shot.
